display.summary: Managed assets become a public API any project can declare, with namespaced pools and permission-checked instant upload; plus a permanent mode for data reset.
highlights: New ManagedAssetField(kind, namespace, reads) declares an asset-backed file field in one line, with the picker, upload and save-time resolution supplied.
Assets carry a namespace, so a picker lists one pool instead of the whole library and de-duplication cannot reach across pools.
Instant upload works on any project form: the endpoint reads the field's own declaration for namespace, kind and permission instead of demanding a superuser.
resolve_asset_selection, apply_asset_pickers, build_asset_field and ManagedAssetFormMixin are public; System Settings now consumes them.
Data reset gained a permanent mode behind a typed confirmation, stopped offering line models, and signals projects to rebuild derived figures.
